en: The image shows a hand-colored photograph of a dam (with a curved structure) and a few buildings on a hillside above it surrounded by trees. The largest building on the hill appears to be a hospice or guesthouse, and there is another distinctly visible house with a red roof. The scene is tranquil and natural, with a body of water to the right. At the top of the image, there is printed text in German: 'Talsperre Marklissa mit Hospiz.'
